long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Barcelona in 1954, Cuatrecasas entered the family law practice after studying law at the University of Navarra. He became managing partner in 1980, when the firm was still small, and drove its transformation into a multidisciplinary business-law partnership. Under his leadership it expanded across Spain, merged with Portuguese practices and established offices in major international financial centres.

Alongside his legal career, Cuatrecasas founded Emesa as a private investment group. Its portfolio combines commercial property with holdings in industrial and service companies, while he currently serves as president and his daughter Inés as chief executive. He later stepped back from the law firm's executive leadership and continues as honorary chairman, maintaining an institutional role while Emesa provides the centre of his current investment activity.
